name: Example: EMC & wiring practice
author: Harness Studio
description: An example team ruleset showing design-oriented rule types. Duplicate and adapt to your own standard.

rules.title: CAN bus not twisted
rules.description: Nets matching ^CAN_ must be in a twisted pair.
rules.rationale: Differential buses need twisting for noise rejection.

rules.title: RF net not individually shielded
rules.description: Nets of class RF must be inside an individual shield.
rules.rationale: Unshielded RF radiates and picks up noise.

rules.title: Power pin adjacent to signal pin
rules.description: Power-class nets must not sit in cavities adjacent to signal-class nets.
rules.rationale: Keeps switching noise away from sensitive lines and improves hipot margins.

rules.title: Power net wire thinner than 20 AWG
rules.description: Power-class nets use 20 AWG or heavier.

rules.title: Net name not upper case
rules.description: Net names use A–Z, 0–9, _ and + only.
rules.rationale: Consistent names across ICDs and test programs.

rules.title: CVD-confusable wire colors on a connector
rules.description: Flags wires on the same connector whose colors are easily confused by color-vision-deficient technicians.
rules.rationale: About 1 in 12 men have a color vision deficiency.

rules.title: RF routed with power
rules.description: RF and power nets should not share a bundle segment.
rules.rationale: Coupling from power switching into RF.
